headline: Choose a shore. Take your time.
opening: A boat crosses open water; birds lift above its wake. Chilika rewards a closer look, but a visit begins with a practical choice: which part of the lagoon do you want to know?
opening_kind: Original narration grounded in the photograph; the visitor question is editorial guidance, not an eyewitness account.

voice.heading: A poet asks the train to wait
voice.original:
ରହ ରହ କ୍ଷଣେ ବାଷ୍ପୀୟଶକଟ,
ଦେଖିବି ଚିଲିକା ଚାରୁ ଚିତ୍ରପଟ ।
voice.author: Gopabandhu Das
voice.translation: Pause a moment, steam carriage; let me see beautiful Chilika.
voice.translation_credit: Project Odisha’s English rendering; language review pending.
voice.context: The poem begins with a request to a steam train: wait. The view keeps appearing and disappearing as the carriage moves on. Gopabandhu’s traveller wants time to look, while the train carries him away. That tension still makes a useful beginning for a visit: choose a part of Chilika you can spend time with.

surprise.heading: Reading the lagoon’s health
surprise.text: CDA’s assessment for 2023–2024 gives Chilika an overall B+ for ecosystem health. Its measures cover water quality, fisheries and biodiversity. Read the grade as a dated ecological assessment, not a score for how beautiful the lake looks.
surprise.reveal: Dissolved oxygen, fish size, bird counts and dolphin abundance measure different parts of the same system. A single overall grade brings them together; it does not mean that every species or every stretch of water is doing equally well.

belief.label: Local legend · one recorded telling
belief.heading: The island that keeps a name
belief.text: In the version recounted by Dr Janmejay Choudhury in Odisha Review, a young bride named Jai is lost when a storm overturns her boat on the journey to her in-laws’ home. The telling links her memory to Kalijai, revered as a protective presence by people travelling on the lagoon.
belief.reflection: Kalijai belongs to Chilika’s living religious landscape as well as its stories.
belief.reflection_kind: Original Utkal interpretation, not a quotation or claim shared by every devotee.
belief.qualification: This is a recorded legend and account of belief, not a verified report of a shipwreck.

invitation.heading: Before you leave the picture…
invitation.text: Look at the boat, the birds and the distant shore. Which would you make time for on your own visit?
invitation.kind: Observation game based on visible image details; no answer collection.
